Stop, no global install needed. wrangler already local devDependency (4.81.1), just not on PATH.

Nix-managed node store, read-only — global npm install always fail EACCES there.

Use local bin instead:

Works fine. `wrangler` bare command not found cuz it's local-only, not global. Use `npx wrangler ...` or `npm run deploy` (package.json already wire that to `wrangler deploy`).

Deploy prod:
```
npx wrangler deploy --env production
```
